A Major Mining Company Sole Funding a Minimum Two-Year Exploration Alliance Under September Term Sheet

Three New Licenses Expected in Early 2027, Vardenis Option Ended to Remove Carrying Costs

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Hayasa Metals Inc. (TSXV: HAY) (OTCQB: HAYAF) ("Hayasa" or the "Company") reports geochemical and assay results from two diamond drill holes totaling 1,052.9 meters ("m") from the western zone of the Company's Urasar Project in northern Armenia.

2026 Drilling Highlights

  • Both holes intersected strong to intense hydrothermal alteration and stockwork veining, consistent with the upper levels of a porphyry-style system.

  • Copper and gold grades were low; mineralized core of the system has not yet been intersected.

  • Hayasa controls 100% of Urasar; seeks a partner for the next phase.

Diamond drill hole UDD-022 tested the Oxide Basin prospect and returned 21.0 m grading 0.08% copper ("Cu") and 0.12 g/t gold ("Au") from 321 to 342 m depth, including 4.0 m with 0.33% Cu and 0.35 g/t Au.

The 21 m elevated gold interval occurs within a longer anomalous interval of 124 m averaging 0.04% Cu and 0.035 g/t Au from 256 to 380 m. The highest individual copper and gold sample in this program returned 0.5% Cu and 0.4 g/t Au from 338 to 340 m.

Hole UDD-023 tested the Silica West zone and returned narrower intervals of elevated copper, including 1.2 m grading 0.2% Cu from 330.8 to 332.0 m. A separate 8.0 m interval from 366 to 374 m averaged 0.05% Cu, and a single 1.6 m sample from 116.3 m returned 19.6 g/t silver ("Ag"). Both holes intersected strong to intense hydrothermal alteration and stockwork veining.

2026 Drilling and Geological Interpretation

This recent drill program tested steeply oriented low-resistivity targets identified on two Audio Magneto Telluric (AMT) profiles at the western end of the Urasar license. Final collar records confirm a combined depth of 1,052.9 m, which is revised from the 1,070 m reported on September 4, 2026. The drill hole targeting was based on the May 2026 six-line, 53-station AMT survey, surface geochemistry and mapped alteration, as well as an earlier 39 m drill intercept averaging 0.50% Cu and 0.18 ppm Au intersected in Hole UDD-021 in Oxide Basin. The two-hole 2026 drill program returned lower copper values than UDD-021 over the broader intervals reported here. These weakly mineralized intervals are hosted in similar brecciated and altered lithologies as intersected in UDD-021.

Both holes intersected multiphase quartz-anhydrite veining with ubiquitous pyrite accessory chalcopyrite, and occasional enargite in strong to intense argillic to advanced argillic alteration. Potassic alteration was observed at depth. These characteristics are consistent with the upper levels of a porphyry-style hydrothermal system.

Figure 1. 2026 drillholes Oblique 3D view showing UDD-022 (Oxide Basin) and UDD-023 (Silica West) in black, 2024-2025 drillholes in blue.



To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/3169/326239_8ef5234b6428499e_003full.jpg

Oxide Basin UDD-022

UDD-022 was completed to 622.0 m and encountered intense silicification from 170.1 to 254.6 m, followed by predominantly propylitic alteration with local silicification and repeated stockwork intervals. The strongest copper and gold values fall within a fault zone from 335.4 to 343.5 m, in a porphyritic unit. Farther downhole, stockwork veining was intersected from 390.0 to 457.6 m and from 483.0 to 503.0 m.

Silica West UDD-023

UDD-023 was completed to 430.9 m. The hole intersected shallow argillic and sericitic alteration, silicification from 44.2 to 224.9 m, and predominantly propylitic alteration from 224.9 m to the end of the hole. Stockwork veining was encountered from 141.0 to 236.1 m and from 264.8 to 430.9 m (end of hole). The higher copper assays occur as short intervals within this lower altered sequence.

Management Comments

Hovo Karapetyan, Chief Geologist and Country Manager, commented: "The pervasive strong to intense alteration, extensive brecciation and widespread sulfide mineralization encountered to date indicate that we are operating within a large and strongly developed hydrothermal system. While our exploration program has completed 23 holes totaling over 5,000 meters, we have yet to intersect the mineralized core of the system. However, the widespread presence of anomalous, albeit low-grade, gold, base metal and arsenic values indicate that we are exploring in the right geological environment. Further analysis of the extensive Hayasa exploration database, together with historical Soviet-era data, is underway to refine our geological understanding and better vector future exploration towards the mineralized core of the system."

Hayasa CEO, Joel Sutherland, adds: "We have now drilled more than 5,000 m at Urasar. These two holes returned lower grades than we were looking for, but the drill core still indicates a system whose center we have yet to find. There is a decent amount of inbound interest on Urasar, the property is 34 km2 and there are additional zones to explore. We will announce our plans on Urasar in early 2027."

Sampling and Analytical Quality Control

Hayasa's local geological team split and sampled the drill core in Armenia. Samples were prepared at the accredited Institute of Mining and Metallurgy in Armenia and analyzed by ALS in Romania, where the laboratory operates to international standards. The 2026 assay workbook lists 590 downhole sample intervals and records ALS methods Au-AA23 (30 g fire assay with an atomic absorption finish for gold) and ME-ICP61 (four-acid digestion with an ICP-AES finish for multi-element analysis).

Hayasa inserted one QA/QC control sample every 20 m of drilling. The control samples comprised standards, duplicates and blanks.

Portfolio Focus and Termination of Vardenis Option

The Company has elected to terminate its option with Mendia Resources on the Vardenis property in central Armenia after the withdrawal of our former partner. This removes the carrying costs of the property and lets the Company concentrate on its strategic exploration alliance with a major mining company in southern Armenia and on the three new exploration licenses it expects to receive in early 2027.

As announced on September 21, 2026, Hayasa signed a term sheet with a major mining company for a strategic exploration alliance focused on copper and other critical metals in southern Armenia. Under the term sheet, the alliance phase has a term of two years and is solely funded by the major mining company. After US$1,000,000 has been spent within the alliance area of interest, the major mining company may earn a 51% interest in a designated project by funding US$1,000,000 on that project over two years, and may increase its interest to 70% by funding a further US$3,000,000 over three years. Hayasa is the operator during the first option period. The term sheet is non-binding except for certain limited provisions, and the alliance remains subject to the negotiation and execution of definitive agreements, which are expected before year end.

As previously announced (see news releases dated April 2 and May 11, 2026), the three license applications are Amasia in northern Armenia, an antimony-nickel-cobalt prospect, Hovo's Reward and Mount Stephanie in central Armenia, which host copper-silver and copper-gold surface anomalies, respectively.

Mr. Sutherland, adds: "Vardenis did a lot for Hayasa Metals and we arguably would not be in a strategic alliance without the work we performed there. We completed robust geophysics and drilled over 5,000 m and worked with an exceptional team of drillers and geologists. We have a lot going on in 2027 with the strategic alliance activity accelerating and the addition of three new exploration licenses."

MONTEREY PARK, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Maison Solutions Inc. (Nasdaq:MSS) (the "Company"), a U.S. specialty grocery retailer focused on Asian food and merchandise, announced that on November 24, 2026 it received a notice of deficiency (the "Notice") from the Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq").

The non-compliance cited by Nasdaq in the Notice is the result of the previously announced departure of Mr. Bin Wang from his position on the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors. With the departure of Mr. Wang, the Company is currently not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2)(A) requiring three independent members on its Audit Committee.

As disclosed in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed on November 23, 2026, the Company notified Nasdaq of the deficiency on November 19, 2026. Mr. Wang's resignation from the Company's Board of Directors and Audit Committee became effective on November 20, 2026, leaving two members on the Audit Committee.

The Notice indicated that, consistent with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(4), Nasdaq will provide the Company a cure period (i) until the earlier of the Company's next annual shareholders' meeting or November 20, 2027, or (ii) if the next annual meeting is held before May 19, 2027, then until no later than May 19, 2027, in order to regain compliance (the "Cure Period").

The Company is actively searching for an additional independent director for its Audit Committee and expects to fill the current vacancy and appoint a third independent director to the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors as soon as practicable and within the Cure Period.

About Maison Solutions Inc.

Maison Solutions Inc. is a U.S. specialty grocery retailer focused on Asian food and merchandise. The Company is committed to providing Asian fresh produce, meat, seafood and other daily necessities in a manner that caters to traditional Asian American family values and cultural norms, while also accounting for the faster-paced lifestyle of younger generations and the diverse makeup of the communities in which the Company operates. The Company's grocery retail operations are located in Southern California and Arizona under the HK Good Fortune and Lee Lee International brands.

For more information about Maison Solutions, please visit www.maisonsolutionsinc.com. Follow the Company on LinkedIn and X.

SANTERAMO IN COLLE, Bari, Italy--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Natuzzi S.p.A. (NYSE: NTZ) (“Natuzzi” or the “Company”), one of the most renowned brands in the production and distribution of design and luxury furniture, today announces that its ordinary and extraordinary shareholders’ meeting (the “Meeting”) was held on November 23, 2026, at the Company’s registered office in Santeramo in Colle (Bari), Italy, and approved all the items on the agenda, as described below.

Extraordinary Shareholders’ Meeting

Reserved Capital Increase. The Meeting approved a capital increase for consideration, in cash, on an indivisible basis, with the exclusion of pre-emptive rights pursuant to Article 2441, paragraph 5, of the Italian Civil Code, reserved for Invest 2003 S.r.l. (“INVEST”), for a total amount of EUR 17,499,998.73 (of which EUR 491,159.10 is allocated to share capital and EUR 17,008,839.63 to share premium) (the “Reserved Capital Increase”), through the issuance of 49,115,910 new ordinary shares at an issue price of EUR 0.3563 per share (approximately US$2.06 per American Depositary Share).

The new shares were paid up in full through the application of the equity reserve earmarked in favor of INVEST, resulting from the irrevocable reclassification of EUR 12.5 million and EUR 5 million of shareholder loans on March 31, 2026 and September 9, 2026, respectively, as capital contributions towards a future capital increase, without any further cash contribution. The new shares will have the same characteristics and dividend entitlement as the outstanding shares.

As previously disclosed, the Reserved Capital Increase forms part of the corporate steps being taken by the Company in connection with its request for review of the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) delisting determination filed on September 10, 2026.

The Reserved Capital Increase was subscribed for in full by INVEST on November 26, 2026 and is fully paid up as of the date hereof, with only the related filing formalities with the competent Companies Register remaining outstanding.

Delegated Rights Issues. The Meeting granted the Board of Directors authority, pursuant to Article 2443 of the Italian Civil Code, to increase the share capital for consideration, in cash, on a divisible basis, on one or more occasions, by June 30, 2027, through two separate rights issues to be offered on a pre-emptive basis to those entitled thereto:

(a) up to a maximum amount of EUR 15,000,000, including share premium, to be offered to all shareholders on a pre-emptive basis and structured to allow minority shareholders, upon full subscription, to restore their percentage shareholdings prior to the Reserved Capital Increase, subject to INVEST’s prior waiver of its pre-emptive rights, described below (the “Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities”); and

(b) up to a maximum amount of EUR 65,000,000, including share premium, through the issuance of up to 1,300,000,000 ordinary shares, to be offered to all shareholders on a pre-emptive basis, with the Board of Directors determining the issue price, terms and timing (the “Delegated Rights Issue”).

As previously disclosed, the Delegated Rights Issue, contemplated by the compliance plan accepted by the NYSE, as announced by the Company on May 22, 2026, is intended to (i) strengthen the Company’s capital structure and enable it to regain compliance, before July 6, 2027, with the US$50,000,000 average global market capitalization or stockholders’ equity standard set out in Section 802.01B of the NYSE Listed Company Manual; and (ii) raise funds to support the Company’s cash flow performance and the successful outcome of the composizione negoziata della crisi (CNC) proceedings, as part of the restructuring process.

The Delegated Rights Issue and the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities both presuppose the successful completion of the Reserved Capital Increase and are independent and non-alternative: the Board of Directors may exercise either or both of the authorities, depending on the Company’s capital strengthening needs, market conditions and the progress of the restructuring process.

In connection with the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities, INVEST delivered to the Company a conditional and limited waiver, dated November 4, 2026, of the pre-emptive rights to which it would be entitled in the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities (the “Waiver”). The Waiver is limited to the number of ordinary shares necessary to enable shareholders other than INVEST, in the event of full subscription, to restore their respective percentage shareholdings held immediately prior to the Reserved Capital Increase.

The Waiver’s effectiveness is subject to the satisfaction of the conditions precedent specified therein, including completion of the Reserved Capital Increase and issuance of the corresponding ordinary shares to INVEST. The Waiver requires that the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities be resolved upon by the Board of Directors, subscribed for and paid up by June 30, 2027, without any automatic or unilateral extension, and does not extend to shares issued in excess of the applicable rebalancing limit.

The Waiver does not extend to the Delegated Rights Issue or to any other capital increase, and INVEST retains its pre-emptive and other rights in respect of such transactions. The Waiver does not constitute a commitment by INVEST to (i) subscribe for any additional ordinary shares, (ii) provide further funding to the Company or (iii) subscribe for any unsubscribed shares.

Elimination of Nominal Value. The Meeting approved the elimination of the indication of the nominal value of the Company’s ordinary shares, previously EUR 1.00 each, which according to Italian law constituted a minimum issue price for new shares, thereby providing flexibility in setting the issue price both for the Reserved Capital Increase and for any subsequent rights issues.

The resolutions adopted at the extraordinary session of the Meeting and described above will take effect upon their registration with the competent Companies Register, which the Company expects to occur in the coming days.

Ordinary Shareholders’ Meeting

Appointment of a Statutory Auditor. The Meeting appointed Mr. Vito Plantone as a standing member of the Board of Statutory Auditors, following the resignation of Mr. Francesco Campobasso. Mr. Plantone will remain in office until the expiration of the term of the current Board of Statutory Auditors, which will occur upon approval of the Company’s financial statements for the year ending December 31, 2027.

Key Terms

pre-emptive rightsfinancial
An investor's pre-emptive rights are the option given to existing shareholders to buy new shares before they are offered to the public or new investors, letting them maintain their percentage ownership and voting power. Think of it like a right of first refusal at a sale: it prevents ownership from being diluted by allowing current holders to keep the same stake, which matters because dilution can reduce influence and the share of future profits.
share premiumfinancial
Share premium is the extra amount investors pay when a company issues new shares above the shares’ stated face (par) value — like paying more than a ticket’s face price because it’s in demand. It matters to investors because that extra money becomes part of the company’s equity, strengthening the balance sheet without adding debt and signaling market interest; it can also be used for certain corporate actions such as buybacks or covering issuance costs.
equity reservefinancial
A portion of a company’s shareholders’ equity that is set aside for a specific purpose and not available for ordinary dividend payments. Equity reserves arise from transactions or accounting rules—examples include share premium from issuing stock above par, revaluation gains, legal or statutory reserves, and stock‑based compensation reserves—and act like a labeled bucket within owners’ equity that affects how much profit can be distributed and how ownership or book values are reported.
american depositary sharefinancial
An American Depositary Share (ADS) is a U.S.-listed certificate that represents a specified number of shares in a foreign company, held by a custodian bank; it works like a receipt that allows U.S. investors to buy and trade foreign equity on American exchanges without dealing with another country’s markets. Investors care because ADSs make foreign stocks easier to access, improve liquidity and settlement in dollars, and can affect dividend payments, voting rights and regulatory oversight compared with buying the underlying foreign shares directly.

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc. (“Slate”) pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 16, 2026 (the “Merger Agreement”). The Pre-Closing Cash Dividend, which Fulcrum estimates will be an aggregate of up to approximately $275.7 million, or up to an estimated $3.6095 per share, will be payable in cash to holders of record of outstanding shares of Fulcrum common stock as of December 7, 2026. The estimated cash dividend is equal in the aggregate to an amount mutually agreed in good faith by Fulcrum and Slate by reference to the amount by which Fulcrum’s Net Cash (as determined pursuant to the Merger Agreement) is expected to exceed $20,300,000 as of the closing of the Merger. The estimated per share dividend is based on 76,381,948 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. The total actual distribution of the amount of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is scheduled to be paid to Fulcrum’s transfer agent on December 10, 2026 (the “Dividend Payment Date”), and may be higher or lower than the estimated amount. The transfer agent will distribute the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend to stockholders within a few days following the Dividend Payment Date.

Payment of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is subject to the final determination of Fulcrum’s Net Cash in accordance with the Merger Agreement. The estimated aggregate Pre-Closing Cash Dividend amount includes approximately $7.0 million of proceeds from the sale of Fulcrum’s early-stage fetal hemoglobin (“HbF”) assets to an unaffiliated third-party pharmaceutical company, which are expected to be funded into escrow prior to the closing of the Merger and credited to Fulcrum’s Net Cash for purposes of the Merger Agreement. SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS), the Company known for its GEN3-series of smart electric tankless water heaters, today announced that its noteholders have converted approximately $5,000,000 in notes into equity. The conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense on the notes. Additional details are included in a Current Report on Form 8-K that the Company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 24, 2026.

The conversion builds on prior debt-to-equity conversions, including approximately $3 million in April 2024, and continues the Company's plan to strengthen its capital structure while aligning investors with the growth of the brand. For plumbing technicians and wholesale partners, that means a manufacturer with more room to invest in inventory, training and support.

The conversion comes as demand accelerates. The Company reported that net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, rose 146% to a record $1,841,929, compared to $748,491 for the same period in 2025. Third quarter net sales grew 62% year over year to $362,790.

Trutankless® continues to expand its wholesale distribution partner network and contractor relationships nationwide, with particularly strong momentum in Arizona, Texas and Florida. Its 14,000-square-foot North Phoenix facility, opened in October 2025, brings production, engineering, installer training and distribution under one roof. In April, it launched the GEN3 Commercial 208V unit, engineered for condominiums, multi-family housing, salons, restaurants, fitness studios and other light commercial settings.

GEN3+, the next generation of the Trutankless® smart electric tankless water heater, is now in production and shipping. The wireless connected unit works with the Trutankless® connected app for homeowners and the Trutankless® Pro app and Pro dashboard for plumbing professionals, all now in beta. The Company plans to share full GEN3+ details in December.

"This conversion strengthens our balance sheet and lets us put more of our resources behind growth," said Guy Newman, CEO of Trutankless®. "Nine-month sales are up 146%, our distributor and contractor network keeps growing, and our Phoenix facility gives us room to scale. With GEN3+ now shipping and our Pro app and Pro dashboard in beta, we are giving plumbing professionals the tools to support every system they install."

About Trutankless®

Trutankless® is the premier brand in electric tankless water heating. The award-winning brand's GEN3 and GEN3+ lineup delivers endless, on-demand hot water in a sleek, space-saving design for homes, condos, multi-family and light commercial spaces.

The Trutankless® connected app is designed to put performance insights and preventative maintenance alerts in the hands of homeowners and plumbing pros, keeping every system running at peak performance, maximizing energy efficiency and extending its service life.

Trutankless® products are sold through plumbing wholesale distributors and dealers nationwide. Founded in 2008, Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS) is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn more at www.trutankless.com.

Vancouver, British Columbia, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NevGold Corp. (TSX-V: NAU) (OTCQX:NAUFF) (Frankfurt:5E50) (“NevGold” or the “Company“) is pleased to announce that the Company will graduate from the TSX Venture Exchange to the senior board Toronto Stock Exchange (the “TSX”) and the common shares of the Company will commence trading on the TSX at the opening of the market on or about December 1, 2026 under its current symbol “NAU”.

CEO, Brandon Bonifacio states “Since forming NevGold and completing our public listing in 2021, we have transformed the Company from an early-stage explorer into a well-funded developer with a portfolio of highly prospective gold, antimony, and copper assets in the Western United States. Our graduation to the TSX from the TSX Venture Exchange is a significant achievement that reflects the hard work of our team and the substantial progress we have made in building shareholder value.

Listing on Canada’s premier senior exchange represents an important milestone in NevGold’s evolution and positions the Company for its next phase of growth. We expect the TSX listing to increase our visibility among institutional and retail investors globally, expand access to capital, and further enhance our standing within the investment community.

As we continue advancing our flagship projects, particularly at a time when domestic sources of critical minerals such as antimony are becoming increasingly strategic, we remain committed to executing our long-term growth strategy and progressing toward becoming a leading emerging gold and antimony producer in North America.”

The Company has received final approval from the TSX for the listing of its common shares. In connection with the listing, the common shares will be voluntarily delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board.

The Company’s trading symbol will remain “NAU” upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board. The CUSIP and ISIN will also remain unchanged. Shareholders are not required to take any action in connection with the Company’s graduation to the TSX, and existing share certificates and direct registration statements will continue to represent Nevgold’s common shares.

In connection with the listing on the TSX, the Company has reconstituted its audit committee to consist of Victor Bradley, Sean Waller and Scott Bensing, each of which is independent as determined under National Instrument 52-110 – Audit Committees. Victor Bradley has been appointed as the lead independent director of the Company.

About the Company
NevGold is dedicated to discovering, de-risking, and rapidly advancing gold and critical metals projects across premier jurisdictions in Nevada and Idaho to drive shareholder value and strengthen US mineral security. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Limousine Butte (gold-antimony) and Cedar Wash (gold) projects in Nevada, and the Nutmeg Mountain (gold) and Zeus (copper) projects in Idaho. For more information, please visit www.nev-gold.com.
